metadata.speaker: Role of the speaker: giver or follower
metadata.addressee: Role of the addressee: follower or giver
metadata.status: Understanding status: aligned, pending, or misunderstood
metadata.reference_start: Start time of the reference expression (seconds)
metadata.reference_end: End time of the reference expression (seconds)
metadata.window_start: Start of the gaze extraction window (seconds)
metadata.window_end: End of the gaze extraction window (seconds)

baseline.spk_prop_partner: Speaker: proportion of window looking at partner
baseline.spk_prop_task: Speaker: proportion of window looking at task
baseline.spk_prop_away: Speaker: proportion of window looking away
baseline.spk_coverage: Speaker: proportion of window with gaze annotation
baseline.spk_transitions: Speaker: changes between contributing gaze labels, including across missing gaps
baseline.spk_entropy: Speaker: Shannon entropy (bits) of durations normalized by observed gaze time
baseline.addr_prop_partner: Addressee: proportion of window looking at partner
baseline.addr_prop_task: Addressee: proportion of window looking at task
baseline.addr_prop_away: Addressee: proportion of window looking away
baseline.addr_coverage: Addressee: proportion of window with gaze annotation
baseline.addr_transitions: Addressee: changes between contributing gaze labels, including across missing gaps
baseline.addr_entropy: Addressee: Shannon entropy (bits) of durations normalized by observed gaze time
baseline.mutual_gaze: Proportion of window with mutual partner gaze

temporal.spk_n_fixations_partner: Speaker: number of partner-directed gaze runs
temporal.spk_n_fixations_task: Speaker: number of task-directed gaze runs
temporal.spk_n_fixations_away: Speaker: number of away-directed gaze runs
temporal.spk_switch_rate: Speaker: gaze transitions per second, using run-label changes / full window duration
temporal.spk_latency_partner: Speaker: normalized latency to first partner gaze (0-1); one if the target is absent
temporal.spk_latency_task: Speaker: normalized latency to first task gaze (0-1); one if the target is absent
temporal.spk_dominant_is_partner: Speaker: 1 if partner is the dominant gaze target
temporal.spk_dominant_is_task: Speaker: 1 if task is the dominant gaze target
temporal.spk_dominant_is_away: Speaker: 1 if away is the dominant gaze target
temporal.spk_first_is_partner: Speaker: 1 if first gaze is toward partner
temporal.spk_first_is_task: Speaker: 1 if first gaze is toward task
temporal.spk_first_is_away: Speaker: 1 if first gaze is toward away
temporal.spk_last_is_partner: Speaker: 1 if last gaze is toward partner
temporal.spk_last_is_task: Speaker: 1 if last gaze is toward task
temporal.spk_last_is_away: Speaker: 1 if last gaze is toward away
temporal.addr_n_fixations_partner: Addressee: number of partner-directed gaze runs
temporal.addr_n_fixations_task: Addressee: number of task-directed gaze runs
temporal.addr_n_fixations_away: Addressee: number of away-directed gaze runs
temporal.addr_switch_rate: Addressee: gaze transitions per second, using run-label changes / full window duration
temporal.addr_latency_partner: Addressee: normalized latency to first partner gaze (0-1); one if the target is absent

temporal.addr_dominant_is_away: Addressee: 1 if away is the dominant gaze target
temporal.addr_first_is_partner: Addressee: 1 if first gaze is toward partner
temporal.addr_first_is_task: Addressee: 1 if first gaze is toward task
temporal.addr_first_is_away: Addressee: 1 if first gaze is toward away
temporal.addr_last_is_partner: Addressee: 1 if last gaze is toward partner
temporal.addr_last_is_task: Addressee: 1 if last gaze is toward task
temporal.addr_last_is_away: Addressee: 1 if last gaze is toward away

coordination.mutual_task: Fraction of jointly observed samples with both participants task-directed; not necessarily the same object
coordination.mutual_partner: Fraction of jointly observed samples with both participants partner-directed
coordination.gaze_alignment: Fraction of jointly observed samples with the same gaze category (including away)
coordination.complementary_gaze: Fraction of jointly observed samples with one partner-directed and the other task-directed
coordination.joint_entropy: Shannon entropy (bits) of ordered joint gaze categories over jointly observed samples
coordination.partner_coupling: Pearson correlation of partner indicators over jointly observed samples; zero if either indicator is constant

derived.partner_asymmetry: Absolute difference in partner gaze between roles
derived.task_asymmetry: Absolute difference in task gaze between roles
derived.entropy_asymmetry: Absolute difference in gaze entropy between roles

metadata.annotator_role: Perspective: EX judges the explainee; EE self-reports understanding
metadata.status: Retrospective judgment: UND, PART_UND, NON_UND, or MISUND (MISSUND normalized)
metadata.label_understood: Pooled annotator-judged target: 1=UND; 0=PART_UND/NON_UND/MISUND; no event aggregation
metadata.window_start: Start of the gaze extraction window (seconds)
metadata.window_end: End of the gaze extraction window (seconds)
